svg.title: Out of the box, one agent reads its own files. Generators write each agent's files into your project and need a rerun after every change and in every new worktree. ctxtra hooks into every agent and adds files from your own folder or a pinned team repo, bound to each project, with nothing written into the projects

g.text: Generators: one source, written out as each agent's files in your project.
Change the source, and those files are stale until you run it again.
A new clone or worktree gets nothing until you generate there too.

g.text: ctxtra: start from the same setup.
Add ctxtra once. It hooks into every supported agent.
Keep your own Markdown files in your own folder.
A binding sends them to my-proj, for every agent and every worktree.
Another project? Bind files from a shared git repo.
It stays at the commit you accepted. Updates wait for your review.
Two projects, two sources, every agent. Nothing written into either project.
